description: Introduces set-valued profunctors as relations with functorial witness sets. Coend composition identifies factorizations along middle-category arrows; finite examples compare discrete and non-discrete composition, and hom profunctors, co-Yoneda, representable profunctors, and coherent associativity explain their bicategory structure.
